verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing claims Rovo AI can create custom automations that move work forward and can automatically assign tasks to the right person, which covers part of AI-driven triage (routing and assignment). There is no evidence that AI classifies or prioritizes incoming bugs; the 'prioritize high-impact work' claim is not tied to AI. Missing for 10: explicit AI classification and prioritization of incoming bugs and tasks, in-depth documentation of a triage feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
